scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@scmp/shared && npm run build --workspace=@scmp/server && npm run build --workspace=@scmp/client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=@scmp/server" "npm run dev --workspace=@scmp/client"
scripts.lint: biome check client server shared scripts
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write client server shared scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@scmp/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@scmp/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@scmp/client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@scmp/server && npm run test --workspace=@scmp/client
